quote: We are deeply grateful for the timely support during this difficult situation (aftermath of floods). Despite the challenging conditions, the team reached our village and distributed essential relief kits to every household.
name: Ms. Jhakra Devi

quote: Sanofi India's association with PPHF has been a long one. Having worked with PPHF on our CSR programs since 2014, we have developed a good working relationship. PPHF provides an in-depth number of resources that truly enable us to implement our CSR programs as per the models devised. We have found PPHF to be good implementation partners who can scale up according to plan and are well networked with state governments’ health infrastructure which facilitates program success. Working with them has provided good learnings for us in our CSR journey.
name: Dr. Kavita Chaudhari

quote: For a long time, I was too weak to move around, and my knees hurt all the time. When the SBIF Sanjeevani Clinic on Wheels came to our village, the doctor gave me medicines and told me what to eat and do every day. Now I feel stronger, my appetite is back and I can walk without much pain. I’m thankful the Mobile Medical Unit visits our village regularly; it has made a big difference for people like me.
name: Mr. Baisanaba Nial

quote: Since the installation of Telehealth kiosk, patient footfall at our centre has increased significantly. People from nearby areas now come here for screening and diagnostic services. Earlier, we had to refer patients elsewhere for ECGs, but now ECGs, HbA1c, spirometry and other pathology tests are available at our centre itself. This has greatly improved access to care and strengthened our services.
name: CHO Ms. Nisha
role: (Sub Centre Dhoom, GB Nagar, Uttar Pradesh)
